description: Wear OS HomeScreen improvements: display all 4 sensor metrics (HR, HRV, SpO2, stress index) during a monitoring session and show a subtle phone-connection indicator.

userStories.title: Display all 4 sensor metrics on the watch monitoring screen
userStories.description: As a researcher wearing the watch, I want to see HR, HRV, SpO2, and stress index on screen during a session so I can verify the sensor is working before leaving the lab.
acceptanceCriteria: HomeScreenContent Monitoring branch shows 4 labelled rows: HR (BPM), HRV (ms), SpO2 (%), Stress (0–100) — each as a separate item{} in the TransformingLazyColumn
Each value displays "..." while its corresponding field in HomeUiState.Monitoring is null, and the actual integer/double value once populated
The existing "Sent: X" counter row remains visible below the metrics
PreviewMonitoring() updated to pass non-null values for hrv, spo2, and stressIndex so the preview compiles and renders all rows
userStories.notes: Only touches wear/src/main/java/com/pl/pulselab/presentation/home/HomeScreen.kt. The data (hrv, spo2, stressIndex) already exists in HomeUiState.Monitoring — this is a pure UI display change. Do not touch HomeViewModel, WearDataSender, or any data layer file.

userStories.title: Show phone-connection indicator when no phone node is found
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want to see a subtle indicator on the watch screen when the phone is not reachable so I know whether data is being relayed before a study begins.
acceptanceCriteria: WearDataSender.send() return type changed from Unit to Boolean — returns true if connectedNodes is non-empty and all sendMessage calls succeed; returns false if nodes list is empty or any exception is caught (existing silent catch behaviour is preserved — no exception propagates)
HomeUiState.Monitoring data class gains one new field: val phoneReachable: Boolean? = null (default null means no send has been attempted yet)

In HomeViewModel, the launch { wearDataSender.send(...) } block captures the Boolean return value and calls _uiState.value = updated.copy(phoneReachable = result, readingsSent = updated.readingsSent + 1)

HomeScreenContent Monitoring branch shows a phone icon row: use Icons.Default.PhoneAndroid with tint MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary when phoneReachable == true; tint MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error when phoneReachable == false; the row is omitted entirely (no item added) when phoneReachable == null
A second preview function PreviewMonitoringNoPhone() added showing the Monitoring state with phoneReachable = false
userStories.notes: Touches three files: WearDataSender.kt (return type + Boolean logic), HomeViewModel.kt (capture return value, update state), HomeScreen.kt (render phone icon). HomeUiState.Monitoring already has a readingsSent field — add phoneReachable alongside it. Icons.Default.PhoneAndroid is available from the material-icons-core artifact already in the wear module.
